I couldn't write `notes/arrow-keys.json` because I have no file or shell tools in this session, so nothing on disk has changed. I worked from the pasted `camera-api.d.ts` and `camera-notes.md` only, and I didn't run the library, so these values are inferred from notes 9, 39 and 57, not measured. I took each held arrow to add its own input independently. Note 9's "normalised" could instead mean the two-key input is a unit vector, which would give 0.71 for both fractions and `true` for the Ctrl check. Also, note 9 says `keyboard: true` is ignored unless `enableArcRotateKeyboardControls()` ran first, so please confirm your viewer calls it.
